assistant|vacuum_recommendation: Dyson Ball Animal 2 recommended for pet hair: 270 Air Watts suction, 30 ft cord, tangle-free turbine tool, whole-machine HEPA filtration

Miele Complete C3 Limited Edition recommended: 1200 Watts, 25 ft cord, HEPA filtration, electrobrush for pet hair

assistant|plant_recommendation: Spider Plant (Chlorophytum comosum): easy to care for, removes formaldehyde and xylene, tolerates varied lighting
Peace Lily (Spathiphyllum wallisii): removes ammonia and benzene, tolerates low light, blooms more in bright indirect light
Dracaena spp.: removes trichloroethylene, formaldehyde, and benzene; can grow up to 10 feet tall
Snake Plant (Sansevieria Trifasciata): hard to kill, removes formaldehyde, benzene, trichloroethylene, thrives in low light
Pothos (Epipremnum aureum): low-maintenance trailing vine up to 8 ft, removes formaldehyde, xylene, toluene
Rubber Plant (Ficus elastica): removes formaldehyde, benzene, trichloroethylene; prefers bright indirect light
Aloe Vera (Aloe barbadensis): purifies air and has medicinal properties; prefers bright indirect light, infrequent watering
Bamboo Palm (Chamaedorea seifrizii): grows up to 12 ft, removes trichloroethylene, formaldehyde, benzene
assistant|planter_advice: Advised planters with bottom drainage holes; terracotta, ceramic, or unglazed clay breathe better than plastic or glazed ceramic
assistant|fertilizer_advice: Advised fertilizing spider/snake plants once a month in spring-summer with balanced water-soluble fertilizer diluted to half strength; skip fall-winter
assistant|fertilizer_recommendation: Miracle-Gro Indoor Plant Food recommended: water-soluble fertilizer designed for indoor plants
Schultz Indoor Plant Food recommended: balanced fertilizer promoting healthy growth
Espoma Organic Indoor Plant Fertilizer recommended: organic slow-release fertilizer
assistant|tv_troubleshooting_advice: Assistant listed 7 common causes of TV flickering: loose connections, faulty cables, power/surge protector issues, overheating from clogged vents, screen settings, outdated firmware, and failing hardware such as backlight
assistant|tv_repair_service_advice: Advised finding TV repair via manufacturer authorized service centers, online directories (Yelp, Angie's List, HomeAdvisor), local electronics stores, or Google search; vet services by reviews, brand/model experience, quote, and warranty
assistant|dust_control_advice: Advised HEPA-filter vacuuming twice weekly, damp microfiber dusting, lint roller for pet hair, regular cat grooming, changing air filters every 1-3 months, dust-repelling fabrics, decluttering, mopping, dehumidifier against dust mites, and robot vacuum
assistant|cat_owner_cleaning_tips: Extra tips for cat owners: wash cat bedding/toys/blankets regularly, keep the cat out of the bedroom for allergy sufferers, and provide a scratching post or cat tower to redirect shedding-causing scratching
assistant|vacuum_buying_factors: Advised choosing pet vacuums based on high suction power (Air Watts or Watts), HEPA filtration trapping 99.97% of allergens, attachments for pet hair, cord length or cordless design, and lightweight compact size
assistant|plant_care_factors: Advised considering lighting (most prefer bright indirect light), avoiding overwatering, humidity needs, ideal temperature range of 65-75°F (18-24°C), and maintenance requirements when choosing indoor plants
assistant|planter_drainage_tips: Additional planter tips: choose one with a built-in saucer to catch drained water, add a drainage layer of perlite, vermiculite, or small rocks if no holes exist, and consider self-watering planters; also use a well-draining indoor potting mix
assistant|fertilizer_precautions: Warned overfertilization can harm plants; advised diluting to half strength to avoid burning roots, using balanced N-P-K ratio such as 20-20-20, and optionally using a soil test kit to check pH and nutrients
